title: The sources the 2026-10-21 census found cited by no article or data line are dropped, re-cited or kept with a reason
goal: Each row of kb/public/_census/2026-10-21.csv with outcome unconfirmed and no used_in value is judged with rag.py src ID --cited: a source only front matter or a ledger note names is dropped from them or re-cited by the fact it backs, and its census row recorded

run: import csv,sys;r=list(csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_census/2026-10-21.csv',encoding='utf-8')));n=[x['id'] for x in r if x['outcome']=='unconfirmed' and not x['used_in'].strip()];print(len(n),'uncited sources unconfirmed');sys.exit(1 if n else 0)

clauses.clause: Each row of kb/public/_census/2026-10-21.csv with outcome unconfirmed and no used_in value is judged with rag.py src ID --cited: a source only front matter or a ledger note names is dropped from them or re-cited by the fact it backs

gates.question: How is a replaced row of the uncited group (129 of the 136, with a superseded_by value) settled: recorded superseded with the id that replaced it, or dropped from _sources.csv? Recommendation: record superseded and keep the row, because the sources file keeps replaced rows, 48 of them are named by ledger notes, and the census outcome vocabulary has superseded for a replaced row.

How are the five live uncited rows that no line names (S1307, S1410, S1420, S1933, S-iqyxq73y) settled: dropped from _sources.csv and _fetch_state.csv and recorded gone, or kept and recorded unconfirmed? Recommendation: drop them and record gone, because no fact, front matter or ledger line names them and the census outcomes have no value for a dropped row but gone.

How are the two live rows that only ledger notes name (S1929 in _conflicts.md, S-agqpl4si in _gaps.md) settled: kept with the ledger file as used_in in the census row and outcome unconfirmed, or dropped and the ledger notes reworded? Recommendation: keep them with the ledger file as used_in, because a ledger note is an append-only record of a page read and its id must resolve, and the census check counts a row with a used_in value as cited.
options: keep with the ledger file as used_in
drop the rows and reword the ledger notes
gates.recommendation: keep with the ledger file as used_in
gates.answer: keep with the ledger file as used_in
